item.title: Israel kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza two months after killing his predecessor as ceasefire stagnates
item.description: Israel killed a senior Hamas commander involved in planning the October 7 attacks only two months after killing his predecessor, a fresh sign of how the Gaza conflict remains active despite a US-brokered ceasefire being in place.

item.title: Bomb threats pose a major question of Europe. But what’s the answer?

item.title: US floated idea of Ukraine swapping land for NATO membership, Zelensky says
item.description: The US floated the idea of Ukraine ceding the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership during recent trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky says.

item.title: The Trump administration is diverting billions in health funding away from low-income countries, defying Congress’ plans
item.description: The Trump administration plans to redirect or withhold nearly all funding that Congress had slated for international family planning aid this year – about $605 million – according to an internal US State Department budget report and a memo to lawmakers that were obtained by CNN.

item.title: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity over UK airbase
item.description: US Air Force personnel at the RAF Lakenheath base in Britain responded to “suspected unauthorized drone activity” on Friday evening, although no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected, a US Air Force spokesperson said.
